subject: general
question: The terminology ‘direct free kick’ is associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Football**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• A free kick is a method of restarting play in association football.
 
• It is awarded after an infringement of the laws by the opposing team. 
 
• These are given regularly in a game as the offenses committed are very common throughout a full match. This is different from the indirect free kick. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton is a single-player game whereas cricket is a team game**. In badminton, it depends on you, and how you execute the game. It's about your day and your hard work. On another side, Cricket needs all players to perform with the bat s well as the ball.
 
• Hockey was considered a national sport **due to the country's dominance from 1928-1956**, a period when the Indian team won 8 gold, 1 silver, and 3 bronze in the Olympics.
